conviction_note: The only thing I found is my own read of public data: segment run-rates from the H1 短信 point to Q3 operating profit roughly flat YoY (about ¥1.38bn), which is below the pace the unrevised H2 plan implies. 経常 (ordinary profit) should run ahead of a guide that assumes too large a non-operating loss. This stock traded the same mixed setup down 9.9% a year ago, but it is already −7% over 20 days and rests on Kewpie-TOB hopes, so the reaction is sized below the −0.8 finding.
bar: Company guide FY2026.11, unrevised since 2026-01-08 and reaffirmed 2026-07-03: OP ¥5,700m, 経常 ¥4,400m, NI ¥2,100m. That implies H2 OP ¥2,740m (+6.5% YoY). Split on last year's Q3 share of H2 (53.6%), the Q3 OP bar is about ¥1,470m. IFIS consensus (thin, one 日系大手 neutral) is OP ¥5,750m and 経常 ¥4,550m, which puts the Q3 OP bar near ¥1,495m. Sources: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260703587699.pdf and https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=9369. print_vs_bar_pct is on OP; on 経常 the same estimate is about +10–14% above the guided pace.

findings.finding: Q3 (Jun–Aug) operating profit looks likely to come in roughly flat YoY near ¥1.38bn, below the ~¥1.47bn Q3 pace the unrevised H2 plan implies, while 経常 runs ahead of a guide that builds in a non-operating loss (~¥410m/quarter in H2) about 1.7x the H1 run-rate (~¥240m/quarter). The basis is H1 segment profits: 共同物流 −23.4%, 専用 +13.9%, 関連 +23.6%. Applied to the Q3 FY25 base (OP ¥1,380m, itself −18.4% YoY), they net to about flat. The consolidated OP trend worsened from +5.4% in Q1 to −9.6% in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same quarter last year (print 2025-09-30): 9M OP −9.7%, Q3 OP −18.4%, guide held, 経常 progress 89.7%. The stock fell 3185→2869 (−9.9%) and kept falling to 2590 by 10-09 (kabutan n202510010747). H1 FY26 (2026-07-03), OP −3.6% with 経常 progress 56.4% above the 5-year average: it opened about −4% and closed +1.4%. Q1 FY26 (OP +5.4%) was about +4.7% in the cadence history. So this stock trades the OP YoY line, not 経常 progress.
findings.why_not_priced: Weakly unpriced at best. The inputs are public, and the thin consensus (OP ¥5,750m, above the company guide) implies analysts have not marked OP down to a flat-Q3 path. If the market expected a Q3 OP miss against plan, the IFIS consensus would sit below the guide rather than above it. The 20-day −7.1% drift partly prices it already, and that drift has no disclosure behind it. It is mostly the unwinding of the May 21 limit-up (Coldrush/TOB hopes).
findings.independence: The quarterly OP series (Q3 FY25 1,380; Q1 FY26 1,289; Q2 FY26 1,671) and the H2-implied plan come from kabutan's own finance table, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9369. It is a second rendering of the same 短信 figures, not independent evidence. Last year's reaction is the only independent support: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9369&b=n202510010747
